geometry: Unchanged D-042 nominal CAD/capsules/sensor box/table and exemptions; no self-collision/fixtures.
time_mapping: Path fractions mapped linearly to recorded segment times for display only; not certified actuator timing.
interval_definition: Contiguous colliding sampled poses; boundaries do not certify exact continuous contact onset.
penetration_distribution: Maximum penetration per colliding motion segment, retaining repeated episodes.
query_parallelism: One Open3D query thread per part; processes across parts. Original pose_clearance unchanged.
transfer_definition: Start/inter-pass plus return home; raw episode transfer_count field counts start/inter-pass only, phase_counts.home is added by the aggregator.
event_schema: events identifies every colliding motion-segment occurrence with episode/step/phase/times/endpoints; join geometry_id to geometries.intervals for EVERY contiguous body/obstacle collision, not just the worst body copied onto the occurrence.
deepest_visualization_definition: Three distinct (part, body, obstacle, exact joint pose) states, ranked by penetration over all body/obstacle intervals; repeated episode occurrences at an identical state are represented once for screenshots only.
status: exploratory diagnostic measurement; canonical source identities retained; no registry write
